changes.after: I have a certificate I received last year. The instructions seem to say 'issued within three months.' Does that mean I should submit it within the next three months?
changes.reason: Source says received last year, not verified issuance last year.

changes.before: Tôi ghi riêng ba việc: mốc ngày cấp, hạn nộp và nội dung bắt buộc. Hôm nay chưa chốt số bản để xin cấp, sẽ tư vấn sau khi có trả lời.
changes.after: Tôi sẽ ghi riêng ba việc: mốc tính ngày cấp, hạn nộp và những nội dung bắt buộc phải ghi. Hôm nay tôi chưa quyết số bản và chưa nộp đơn xin cấp; tôi sẽ trao đổi lại sau khi nhận được câu trả lời.
changes.reason: Restore explicit postponement of issuance application and correct speaker consulting rather than giving consultation.

changes.before: শুধু ছবি থেকে ভিত্তি ঠিক নয়। জমার জায়গা থেকে পুরো নির্দেশ আনান। সনদের নাম এক?
changes.after: শুধু এই ছবি থেকে সময় গণনার ভিত্তি নির্ধারণ করা যাবে না। যে প্রতিষ্ঠানে জমা দেবেন, তাদের পুরো নির্দেশনা পাঠাতে বলুন। সনদের নাম কি মিলে যাচ্ছে?
changes.reason: Replace assertion that basis is wrong with source uncertainty: basis cannot be determined from photo alone.

changes.before: ইস্যুর ভিত্তি, জমার সীমা, দরকারি লেখা তিনটি আলাদা লিখব। আজ কপির সংখ্যা ঠিক করে আবেদন নয়, উত্তর পরে পরামর্শ নেব।
changes.after: ইস্যুর তারিখের ভিত্তি, জমা দেওয়ার শেষ সময় এবং প্রয়োজনীয় বিবরণ—এই তিনটি বিষয় আলাদা করে লিখে রাখব। আজ কপির সংখ্যা ঠিক করে ইস্যুর আবেদন করব না; উত্তর পাওয়ার পর পরামর্শ নেব।
changes.reason: Restore complete statement, issue-date basis, required contents and deferred application.

changes.before: Khi khám tôi cũng giải thích không dùng hằng ngày nhưng có thuốc đã dùng. Tôi không để nguyên chữ không, sẽ tư vấn không đoán số viên chưa biết.
changes.after: Khi khám, tôi cũng sẽ giải thích rằng tôi có dùng thuốc, dù không phải hằng ngày. Tôi sẽ sửa mục đã ghi là ‘không có’ và hỏi ý kiến mà không đoán số viên mình không nhớ.
changes.reason: Correct consulting role: patient asks advice, does not provide consultation.

changes.before: Nói sửa mục không có, báo bác sĩ thuốc thỉnh thoảng dùng, không đoán số viên mà tư vấn. Hãy nói bằng tiếng Nhật.
changes.after: Hãy nói bằng tiếng Nhật rằng sẽ sửa mục ‘không có’, báo bác sĩ về thuốc thỉnh thoảng dùng và hỏi ý kiến mà không đoán số viên chưa rõ.
changes.reason: Keep hint aligned with patient seeking advice and correcting none.

changes.before: इसे प्रश्नपत्र में जोड़ूँगा। फोटो तैयार रखें ताकि जाँच में लक्षणों के साथ डॉक्टर को दिखा सकें।
changes.after: मैं यह जानकारी चिकित्सा प्रश्नावली में जोड़ दूँगा। दवा की फोटो तैयार रखिए ताकि जाँच के समय दिखा सकें, और अपने लक्षणों के साथ यह जानकारी डॉक्टर को भी बताइए।
changes.reason: Medical questionnaire is not an examination question paper; retain speaking about symptoms, not showing symptoms.

changes.before: প্রশ্নপত্রে যোগ করব। ওষুধের ছবি প্রস্তুত রাখুন, লক্ষণসহ ডাক্তারকে দেখান।
changes.after: এই তথ্য চিকিৎসার প্রশ্নাবলিতে যোগ করব। চিকিৎসকের কাছে দেখানোর জন্য ওষুধের ছবিটি হাতের কাছে প্রস্তুত রাখুন এবং আপনার উপসর্গের সঙ্গে এই তথ্যও চিকিৎসককে জানান।
changes.reason: Clarify clinical questionnaire and report symptoms rather than display symptoms on a question paper.

changes.before: Tôi tư vấn với trạng thái chưa xác minh là chính bạn. Tôi giữ trò chuyện, xác nhận qua số cũ, không chỉ tên hiển thị mà cho là thật.
changes.after: Tôi sẽ hỏi ý kiến và nói rõ rằng chưa xác minh được có phải chính bạn mình liên lạc hay không. Tôi sẽ giữ lại cuộc trò chuyện và xác nhận qua số điện thoại đã biết từ trước. Tôi sẽ không chỉ dựa vào tên hiển thị để cho là thật.
changes.reason: Correct requester role and express unverified identity clearly.

changes.before: จดสองอย่างแยก อีกฝ่ายกำหนดจ่ายด้วยไหมครับ/คะ?
changes.after: เราจดข้อมูลสองอย่างนี้แยกกันนะครับ/คะ อีกฝ่ายได้กำหนดเส้นตายในการจ่ายเงินด้วยไหมครับ/คะ?
changes.reason: Restore payment deadline rather than merely specifying payment.

changes.before: बताएँ कि पहुँचने का वादा नहीं, आज भेजना निश्चित नहीं, भुगतान बाद पहुँच अनुमान पूछकर परिवार को बताएँगे। जापानी में कहें।

changes.after: এখনও প্রতিশ্রুতি দিইনি। আজই পাঠানো যাবে ধরে নেব না। টাকা দেওয়ার পদ্ধতি ঠিক হওয়ার পর সম্ভাব্য পৌঁছানোর সময়ও জেনে পরিবারকে জানাব।

changes.after: বলুন যে পৌঁছানোর দিনের প্রতিশ্রুতি দেননি, আজই পাঠানো নিশ্চিত ধরে নেবেন না এবং টাকা দেওয়ার পদ্ধতি ঠিক করার পর পৌঁছানোর সম্ভাব্য সময় জেনে পরিবারকে জানাবেন। জাপানিতে বলুন।

changes.before: বিলে তথ্য আছে, নিজে ঊনত্রিশ হাজার ছয়শ সত্তর কমিয়ে এখন পাঠাবেন না বলুন। জাপানিতে বলুন।

changes.after: বুঝেছি। এখনও টাকা পাঠানো হয়নি। খরচসহ মোট টাকা আবার প্রস্তুত করতে পারেন, অথবা আগে অন্য পদ্ধতি ব্যবহারের শর্ত জানতে পারেন।

changes.before: Tôi trả tờ một nghìn. Nhận hóa đơn và thối phần này trước rồi trả đồ nhà.
changes.after: Tôi sẽ trả phần đồ dùng công việc bằng tờ 1.000 yên này. Tôi muốn nhận biên lai và tiền thối lại của phần này trước, rồi mới thanh toán đồ dùng ở nhà.

changes.before: Thối ba trăm hai mươi và hóa đơn việc. Tiếp nhà bốn trăm hai mươi cũng mặt sao?
changes.after: Đây là 320 yên tiền thối lại và biên lai cho đồ dùng công việc. Tiếp theo, đồ dùng ở nhà hết 420 yên. Phần này anh/chị cũng trả bằng tiền mặt phải không?
changes.reason: Restore complete cash-payment question from truncated mặt and identify receipt/change categories.

changes.before: Oo, 680 at 420 ang dalawang natanggap. Hihiwalayin ko rin ang gamit sa bag bago umuwi.
changes.after: Oo, natanggap ko na ang dalawang resibo, para sa 680 yen at 420 yen. Paghihiwalayin ko rin ang mga pinamili sa kani-kanilang bag bago umuwi.
changes.reason: Specify receipts rather than implying two cash amounts received.

changes.before: Mang sơ đồ này. Chưa hướng dẫn mở thì không vào lối nhỏ, hãy vui tuyến quanh quảng trường.
changes.after: Anh/chị hãy mang theo sơ đồ này. Đừng vào lối nhỏ cho đến khi có thông báo cho phép đi lại. Chúc anh/chị đi dạo vui vẻ trên tuyến đường quanh quảng trường.
changes.reason: Restore complete natural NPC instruction and reopening condition.

changes.before: Bisa keliling lapangan terbuka, tidak ke cabang menuju jalan kecil. Bangku tengah juga bisa digunakan.
changes.after: Kalau begitu, Anda bisa berjalan mengelilingi lapangan yang terbuka. Jangan mengambil cabang menuju jalan kecil itu. Bangku-bangku di sepanjang rute juga bisa digunakan.
changes.reason: 途中 benches are along the route, not necessarily in the middle of plaza.

changes.before: বন্ধুকে চত্বর প্রবেশে দেখা বলব। পরীক্ষা তাড়াতাড়ি শেষ হবে না ধরে আজ খোলা জায়গাতেই হাঁটব।
changes.after: বন্ধুকে চত্বরের প্রবেশপথে দেখা করার জন্য জানাব। পরিদর্শন তাড়াতাড়ি শেষ হবে এমন আশা না করে আজ শুধু খোলা অংশেই হাঁটব।
changes.reason: Restore not relying on early completion; avoid asserting inspection will not finish early.

changes.before: Sau đó xem chỉ dẫn đúng tàu để quyết. Cũng muốn kiểm tra bản thân nên so chỗ nào không?
changes.after: Sau đó, anh/chị hãy cân nhắc dựa trên thông tin của đúng chuyến tàu đó. Anh/chị có muốn kiểm tra cả những mục trên bảng mà mình cần đối chiếu không?
changes.reason: Restore complete natural question about display fields to compare.

changes.before: Ipakita pangalan at destinasyon, humingi ng tamang tren nang hindi pareho lahat mula bahagyang anunsiyo. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.
changes.after: Ipakita ang pangalan at destinasyon ng tren at humingi ng impormasyon tungkol sa tren na iyon, nang hindi ipinagpapalagay mula sa bahagi lang ng anunsiyo na pare-pareho ang lahat. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.
changes.reason: Request information about train, not request the correct train itself.

changes.before: ट्रेन न बदल जाए इसकी जाँच स्पष्ट हुई। हम अभी की सूचना देखते हैं, कृपया योजना की स्क्रीन दिखाते रहें।
changes.after: अब आपने समझ लिया कि संबंधित ट्रेन की पहचान में गलती होने से कैसे बचना है। मैं उस ट्रेन की वर्तमान सूचना जाँचूँगा, इसलिए कृपया अपने यात्रा-कार्यक्रम की स्क्रीन इसी तरह दिखाते रहिए।
changes.reason: Avoid implying train changes; source is preventing confusion between target trains.

changes.before: Chúng tôi nhận là một tư vấn của mình và yêu cầu người đi kèm. Muốn ngôn ngữ gì, đặc biệt lo giải thích chỗ nào?
changes.after: Chúng tôi sẽ ghi nhận đây là một việc cần tư vấn của anh/chị, kèm mong muốn có người đi cùng. Anh/chị muốn được hỗ trợ bằng ngôn ngữ nào và đặc biệt lo ngại điểm nào trong phần giải thích?
changes.reason: Correct NPC saying your consultation instead of ambiguous mình; complete natural request.

changes.before: Saya sore hari kerja, teman saat libur. Saya lihat jadwal kerja untuk mengusulkan hari cocok.
changes.after: Saya bisa datang pada siang hingga sore hari pada hari kerja, sedangkan teman saya bisa datang pada hari libur kerjanya. Saya ingin melihat jadwal kerja dan mengusulkan tanggal yang cocok untuk kami berdua.
changes.reason: 午後 covers afternoon, not only late-afternoon sore; retain friend's work-day-off restriction.

changes.before: Sampaikan sore hari kerja untuk Anda, teman hari libur, dan melihat jadwal untuk tanggal cocok. Sampaikan dalam bahasa Jepang.
changes.after: Katakan bahwa Anda bisa datang pada siang hingga sore hari pada hari kerja, teman Anda pada hari libur kerjanya, dan Anda akan melihat jadwal kerja untuk mengusulkan tanggal yang cocok bagi keduanya. Sampaikan dalam bahasa Jepang.
changes.reason: Align afternoon availability and mutually suitable candidate dates.
